_format: How to assemble the scenes. Coordinates in data/scenes/*.json are image pixels with scene padding 0. Elevations are in feet (grid distance 5 ft = 100 px). 'preferred' is a single v14 Scene with three native Levels; 'fallback' is three separate Scenes linked by teleport regions. Build the preferred layout if the v14 Level schema supports what is described; otherwise build the fallback. Either way, keep every flag in flags.ravenmoor so the macros can find walls, lights and tiles by label or group.

levels.name: Upper Floor
levels.backgroundNote: Transparent outside the house and over the open Great Hall, so the ground level shows through below if the Level renderer composites lower levels.

preferred.levelChanges: Every entry in levelRegions becomes a Region on its level with a Change Level behavior targeting the 'connectsTo' level. Both hidden-stair regions (on the upper and below levels) start disabled and are enabled by the Reveal Secret Door macro.

scenes.name: Ravenmoor: Upper Floor
scenes.backgroundNote: Standalone version: opaque, with roofs painted over the ground-floor areas.

scenes.name: Ravenmoor: The Showdown (crypt battle map)
scenes.cropNote: Subtract crop.x / crop.y from every wall, light, note, tile, token and region coordinate, and drop anything that falls outside the crop.

fallback.levelChanges: Every entry in levelRegions becomes a Region with a Teleport Token behavior to the matching region on the 'connectsTo' scene (the rectangles are identical on both sides because the canvases are aligned). Both hidden-stair regions start disabled.

tokens.note: Values are Foundry constant names; resolve them to numbers at build time. Do not give player tokens a light; the candles carry the mood. Darkvision comes from the character sheets.
tokens.placed: Each placed token in data/scenes/*.json carries hidden: true/false. Hidden at start: Silas's body token (upper), Quill and the four skeletons (below). The two scarecrows stand visible in the crypt corner all night and look like ordinary scarecrows; the showdown setup makes them hostile.

defaults.walls: Use each wall's move/sight/light/sound/door/ds values as given. flags.ravenmoor.kind is one of ext, int, window, rail, brick, door, secret, open.
defaults.lights: Use config as given (dim/bright are radii in feet). flags.ravenmoor.group 'hall_candles' marks every light the Widow blows out. A light with hidden: true starts off. Find single lights by label prefix (e.g. "Hallows' brazier", 'Warding lantern').
defaults.notes: Every map pin is a GM tool: it links to a page in the GM-only Ravenmoor Locations journal, so players never see pins (Foundry hides a note from users who cannot view its page). A note with a locationKey links to that page. A note with locationKey null uses parentKey for its page and shows its own label as the note text. secret: true marks the pins that would give away the passage; give them a different icon so the GM never reveals them by accident.
defaults.tiles: Evidence tiles start hidden; macros find them by flags.ravenmoor.label prefix (the text before the parenthesis, e.g. 'C4 foxfire smears').
defaults.clueNotes: Optionally add one GM-only map note per card in data/content/handouts.json that has a mapPos, linked to that card's page in the Handouts & Clues journal, with an icon different from the location pins.

does: lock the 'East Corridor / Study' door (ds 2)
move Silas's token into the study chair
flash a green light on the minstrels' gallery (around grid 24, 11 on the upper level) for a few seconds: the Widow's lantern
hide every light in group hall_candles (the Great Hall candelabras and fire on the ground level, the gallery sconces on the upper level)
play a gust sound if one is configured
reveal tile 'C4 foxfire smears' on the upper level
post the DC 13 Wisdom save request with the Scaredy-Cat button
replace Silas's token with the body token (Dead status) in the study
reveal tiles 'C2 wet footprints' and 'Scattered lilies'
set the 'East Corridor / Study' door to open (it was broken in)
show Handout 2 to all players
start the Twelve Candles clock
reveal tile 'C5 buckled boot print' on the ground level

stateTriggers.when: C3 found, or stuck ladder rung 3
does: set the bookcase secret door (upper, label 'Bookcase (secret door)') to a normal door, open
set the tomb secret door (below, label "Hidden door behind Elspeth's tomb") to a normal door
enable both hidden-stair regions
post a GM whisper: Escalation 1, only if Quill is out of sight
post a GM whisper: Escalation 2 (lockbox key in Edric's coat)
move the Lockbox Key item into Edric's inventory if it is still on Quill
post a GM whisper: Escalation 3 (Fennick's lights; Quill to the chapel)
add Fennick's token on the drive

stateTriggers.when: Candle 12 snuffed, or the DM rings the bell
does: toll the bell (chat card plus optional sound)
reveal the green brazier light and tile 'Green brazier fire' on the below level
open the Accusation dialog (who/how/why)

stateTriggers.when: Combat starts on the below level
does: insert a 'Midnight Bell' combatant at initiative 20 (loses ties), unless dnd5e handles lair initiative natively
run lair round N on its turn (see npcs.json quill.lair.rounds)
skip round 1 if the Why edge was granted

stateTriggers.when: Quill drops to 30 HP or fewer (50 if the DM toggles 'running long')
does: swap Quill's token image to quill-unmasked.webp
mark Quill defeated/surrendered and end his turns
delete or mark defeated every skeleton; mark scarecrows defeated
post the unmasking line to chat
tint the six 'Warding lantern' lights green
show the Lantern Widow token on the pond for the epilogue
place Elspeth's Lantern as an item pile or give it to the party
